system.description:
The character regenerates Health or Energy each round. Must choose one focus when assigned.

  • Level 1: Regenerates up to 5 HP or EP per round
  • Level 2: Regenerates up to 10 HP or EP per round
  • Level 3: Regenerates up to 15 HP or EP per round
  • Level 4: Regenerates up to 20 HP or EP per round
  • Level 5: Regenerates up to 25 HP or EP per round
  • Level 6: Regenerates up to 30 HP or EP per round
